brand.name: Evernear
brand.tagline: Distance doesn't have to feel so far.

demo.banner: Demo environment: products, partners and payments shown here are placeholders. No real orders are fulfilled.
demo.destinationNote: Demo destinations only. Confirmed delivery coverage will be listed here once local partners are in place.

home.heroTitle: Send something that says you're still close.
home.heroBody: Evernear helps you send flowers, cakes, chocolates, plants and store gift cards to the people you love in Syria and Iraq — with a message in your own words.
home.giftCardsTitle: Let them choose, from a store they already know
home.giftCardsBody: Store gift cards are bought here and redeemed locally. Face value is shown in the store's currency; you pay in yours.

howSteps.title: Choose a destination
howSteps.body: Pick the country and city. You'll only see gifts that can actually be delivered there.

howSteps.title: Pick a gift and write your message
howSteps.body: Flowers, cake, a plant, or a store gift card. Add a note in your own words.

howSteps.title: Tell us who it's for and when
howSteps.body: Recipient's name, phone and address, and the delivery date you'd like.

howSteps.title: We take it from there
howSteps.body: You'll get an order reference and updates as the gift moves toward its recipient.

home.occasionsTitle: For the moments you'd rather not miss

catalog.title: Gifts
catalog.subtitle: Everything here can be delivered to the city you've chosen.
catalog.emptyBody: Try clearing a filter, or choose a different destination.
catalog.noDestinationTitle: Choose a destination to see what's available
catalog.noDestinationBody: Gifts and gift cards differ by city. Pick where you're sending to and we'll show what can be delivered there.

product.giftMessageHint: Optional. Written on a card and included with the gift.
product.notAvailableHere: Not available in your selected city
product.deliveryCopy: Delivery dates are chosen at checkout and follow the local calendar of the destination city.
product.demoImage: Illustration placeholder — real product photography is added through the admin dashboard.

giftCards.title: Store gift cards
giftCards.subtitle: Bought here, redeemed locally. The recipient shops at a store they already know.
giftCards.difference: Gift cards are not shipped like a bouquet. Depending on the store, the recipient receives a code, a physical card, or a hand-delivered voucher arranged by our team.
giftCards.fulfillmentDigital: Digital code sent to the recipient
giftCards.fulfillmentPhysical: Physical card delivered to the recipient
giftCards.fulfillmentManualHint: A team member confirms the card with the store and delivers it to the recipient. You'll see progress in order tracking.
giftCards.recipientNote: You'll add the recipient's details and your personal message at checkout.
giftCards.emptyTitle: No gift cards for this destination yet
giftCards.emptyBody: Partner stores are added city by city. Try another city or browse physical gifts.
giftCards.facePriceNote: Face value is what the card is worth at the store. The price you pay is shown in your currency and includes Evernear's service. No exchange rate is applied or implied.

cart.title: Your cart
cart.emptyBody: Add a gift or a gift card and it will show up here.
cart.deliveryTbd: Delivery fee is calculated at checkout
cart.checkoutSoon: Checkout is part of the next build stage.
cart.conflictTitle: Your cart is for a different city
cart.conflictBody: An order can only go to one city. Start a new cart for {city}, or keep the one you have.
cart.mixedNote: This cart has both a physical gift and a gift card. They'll be delivered separately but belong to one order.

footer.legalNote: Legal pages are drafts awaiting professional review.

common.errorBody: Please try again. If it keeps happening, contact us.
common.notFoundBody: It may have moved, or the link may be incomplete.
common.draft: Draft — requires professional review before publication.
